abstract: We develop a simple theory of realized illiquidity, defined as the ratio of realized volatility to trading volume. Building on the widely used price impact measure of Amihud (2002), we introduce the realized Amihud, which significantly improves measurement accuracy. Our theoretical and numerical results show that it robustly captures cumulative intraday price sensitivity to trading, accounting for stochastic volatility, microstructure noise, and information jumps. Empirically, we uncover distinct time-series patterns in realized stock illiquidity—heterogeneous clustering, leverage effects—and show that it predicts short-term returns. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [SNSF Grant 182303]. P. Santucci de Magistris also acknowledges the research support of the Project 2 Grant of the Danish Council for Independent Research (IRFD), Social Sciences, No. 8019-00015A, and of the European Union’s - Next Generation EU program through the Italian PRIN 2022 -M4C2, Investment 1.1 - “Monitoring Risks in Financial Markets” – Codice Cineca: 2022NEL482 - CUP: I53D23003410008. D. Lacava acknowledges that part of this research was carried out while he was affiliated with Luiss University, within the project “Financial Modeling under Non-Gaussian Distributions”. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505 .
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于已实现非流动性的简洁理论，将其定义为已实现波动率与交易量的比率。基于Amihud（2002）广泛使用的价格冲击度量，我们引入了已实现Amihud指标，显著提升了测量精度。我们的理论和数值结果表明，该指标稳健地捕捉了日内价格对交易的累积敏感性，同时考虑了随机波动率、微观结构噪声和信息跳跃。在实证方面，我们揭示了已实现股票非流动性的独特时间序列模式——异质性聚类、杠杆效应——并展示了其对短期收益的预测能力。本文由Agostino Capponi（金融领域）接受。资金支持：A. Ranaldo感谢瑞士国家科学基金会的资助[项目编号182303]。P. Santucci de Magistris亦感谢丹麦独立研究委员会（IRFD）社会科学领域项目2资助（编号8019-00015A），以及欧盟“下一代欧盟”计划通过意大利PRIN 2022 -M4C2，投资1.1——“金融市场风险监测”——Cineca代码：2022NEL482 - CUP: I53D23003410008提供的支持。D. Lacava感谢部分研究在Luiss大学进行，隶属于“非高斯分布下的金融建模”项目。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505获取。
title: Realized Illiquidity
title_zh: 实现非流动性

abstract: We find that shifts toward more liberal (i.e., less probusiness) courts predict reductions in local small business activity. A one-standard-deviation increase in liberal ideology predicts a 1% reduction in firm count relative to bordering counties in different federal court jurisdictions. This effect has more than doubled since 2000 and is particularly pronounced in circuit-years with elevated small business–related federal cases or public attention to the legal environment. The effect manifests predominantly through the exit of young firms, not firm relocations, and coincides with a shift away from litigation-sensitive industries. In summary, we provide the first evidence that small businesses consider judicial ideology, and the accompanying variation in expected litigation costs, when deciding whether or where to operate. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333 .
abstract_zh: 我们发现，转向更自由（即较少亲商）的法院预测地方小企业活动减少。自由派意识形态每增加一个标准差，相对于不同联邦法院辖区内的相邻县，企业数量预计减少1%。这一效应自2000年以来已翻倍以上，在涉及小企业相关联邦案件或法律环境受到公众关注度较高的巡回法院年份中尤为显著。该效应主要通过年轻企业的退出显现，而非企业迁移，并且与诉讼敏感行业的转移同时发生。总之，我们提供了首个证据表明，小企业在决定是否经营或在哪里经营时，会考虑司法意识形态及其伴随的预期诉讼成本变化。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Small Business Judging Judges
title_zh: 小企业评判法官

abstract: Firms increasingly rely on voluntary training programs to enhance employees’ skills, yet such initiatives often suffer from high dropout rates. We investigate whether providing employees with information about their relative training performance affects their persistence in voluntary training. Social comparison theory suggests that relative performance information (RPI) addresses employees’ inherent need to assess their ability relative to others and maintain a positive self-image by improving their standing. However, whether RPI on training performance is sufficient to increase persistence in voluntary training in the field is unclear. Besides particularly low barriers for dropping out, voluntary training is typically noncore to employees’ primary tasks and often lacks a meaningful comparison group because participants come from a large, heterogeneous, and largely anonymous pool of employees. This calls into question whether the conditions required for social comparison mechanisms are sufficiently met for RPI to take effect. We study this question using a field experiment in a firm offering a voluntary online training program. During the training, employees either receive RPI about their training performance relative to others or only their own performance score. We show that RPI significantly increases employees’ persistence in the training. Consistent with our proposed theoretical mechanism, this effect is particularly pronounced for more competitive individuals. We further find that the likelihood of completing the training is higher and people return to the training quicker if they receive RPI. Our study highlights a simple and cost-effective way to enhance the effectiveness of voluntary training. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448 .
abstract_zh: 企业日益依赖自愿性培训项目来提升员工技能，然而此类举措常面临高辍学率的问题。我们探讨了向员工提供其相对培训表现的信息是否会影响他们在自愿培训中的坚持度。社会比较理论认为，相对表现信息（RPI）满足了员工评估自身相对于他人能力的内在需求，并通过提升自身地位来维护积极的自我形象。然而，在实地环境中，关于培训表现的RPI是否足以增强自愿培训的坚持度尚不明确。除了退出的门槛特别低之外，自愿培训通常不是员工主要任务的核心部分，且往往缺乏有意义的比较群体，因为参与者来自一个庞大、异质且基本匿名的员工群体。这引发了疑问：社会比较机制所需的条件是否充分满足，以使RPI发挥作用。我们通过在一家提供自愿在线培训项目的公司进行实地实验来研究这一问题。在培训期间，员工要么收到关于其相对于他人培训表现的RPI，要么仅收到自己的表现分数。我们表明，RPI显著提高了员工在培训中的坚持度。与我们提出的理论机制一致，这一效应在更具竞争性的个体中尤为显著。我们进一步发现，如果员工收到RPI，他们完成培训的可能性更高，并且返回培训的速度更快。我们的研究突显了一种简单且成本效益高的方式来增强自愿培训的有效性。本文被Jan Bouwens（会计学）接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: The Impact of Relative Performance Information on Employees’ Persistence in Voluntary Training
title_zh: 相对绩效信息对员工自愿培训坚持度的影响

abstract: We study how consumer feedback affects a credence good market where consumers sequentially visit a monopolistic expert. Each consumer's problem can be minor or major. Before treatment, the expert performs a diagnosis which may fail. Each consumer reveals the received treatment and its outcome. Consumers observe feedback history and decide whether to visit the expert. We find that consumer feedback can lead to inefficiency. When diagnosis fails, the expert overtreats consumers even though the probability of a major problem is low. This behavior does not arise without consumer feedback.
abstract_zh: 我们研究消费者反馈如何影响一个信任品市场，在该市场中，消费者依次访问垄断专家。每位消费者的问题可能是轻微的或严重的。在治疗前，专家进行诊断，但诊断可能失败。每位消费者会透露所接受的治疗及其结果。消费者观察反馈历史并决定是否访问专家。我们发现，消费者反馈可能导致效率低下。当诊断失败时，即使严重问题的概率较低，专家也会过度治疗消费者。这种行为在没有消费者反馈的情况下不会出现。
title: Credence Goods, Consumer Feedback and (in)Efficiency
title_zh: 信任品、消费者反馈与（非）效率

abstract: We propose a new approach to pollution control from the social contract perspective, which highlights the reciprocal obligations between firms and the government, in contrast to the conventional regulatory view. Combining granular data on Chinese industrial firms with a 2007 reform that sharply increased the government’s incentives for pollution control, we show, in a difference-in-differences framework, that firms with prior government support achieved greater emission reductions than those without following the reform, primarily through costly clean technology adoption and output cuts. These effects are consistent across various strategies that account for the potential endogeneity of government support and appear to be driven by reciprocity between firms and the government, as (a) the effects are more pronounced in regions with stronger norms of reciprocity, and (b) the government, in turn, responded with continued support. Alternative explanations—including government leverage, financial constraints, regulatory enforcement, and political connections—cannot explain our findings. We further examine the aggregate implications of firm-government reciprocity at the city level, exploiting quasi-random variation in city-level support induced by plausibly exogenous mayoral rotation and across-mayor variation in support preferences in an instrumental variable design. We find that such reciprocity translated into significant declines in regional pollution concentrations, thereby enhancing the government’s capacity for pollution control.
abstract_zh: 我们从社会契约视角提出一种新的污染控制方法，该方法强调企业与政府之间的互惠义务，与传统的监管观点形成对比。结合中国工业企业层面的精细数据与2007年一项大幅增强政府污染控制激励的改革，我们在双重差分框架下发现，相较于未获得政府支持的企业，那些先前获得政府支持的企业在改革后实现了更大的减排，主要通过采用成本高昂的清洁技术和削减产出实现。这些效应在多种考虑政府支持潜在内生性的策略中保持一致，并似乎由企业与政府之间的互惠关系驱动，具体表现为：(a) 在互惠规范更强的地区，效应更为显著；(b) 政府相应地以持续支持作为回应。其他替代解释——包括政府杠杆、融资约束、监管执行及政治关联——均无法解释我们的发现。我们进一步在城市层面考察企业-政府互惠的总体影响，利用由看似外生的市长轮换及市长间支持偏好差异引起的城市层面支持的准随机变化，采用工具变量设计。我们发现，这种互惠关系转化为区域污染浓度的显著下降，从而增强了政府的污染控制能力。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Reciprocity and state capacity: Evidence from a national pollution control reform in China
title_zh: 互惠与国家能力：来自中国全国性污染治理改革的证据

abstract: How does drug quality affect self-medication behavior? We address this question in the context of Burkina Faso, where self-medication with antibiotics is widespread. Using chemical quality tests, we find that one in three antibiotics on the market is substandard or falsified, posing significant health risks. While consumers are broadly aware of the prevalence of poor-quality drugs, they struggle to assess quality based on observable cues such as price or packaging. To identify causal effects, we conduct a novel lab-in-the-field experiment that varies the probability of purchasing effective medicine. We find that self-medication increases as drug quality becomes more certain. These results suggest that market-level interventions to improve drug quality may unintentionally increase inappropriate antibiotic use, with implications for health policy and antimicrobial resistance.
abstract_zh: 药物质量如何影响自我药疗行为？我们在布基纳法索的背景下探讨这一问题，该国抗生素自我药疗现象普遍。通过化学质量检测，我们发现市场上三分之一的抗生素为劣质或伪造药品，构成重大健康风险。尽管消费者普遍意识到劣质药物的普遍存在，但他们难以依据价格或包装等可观察线索评估药品质量。为识别因果效应，我们开展了一项新颖的实地实验，该实验改变了购买有效药物的概率。我们发现，随着药物质量确定性提高，自我药疗行为增加。这些结果表明，旨在改善药品质量的市场层面干预措施可能无意中加剧不当抗生素使用，这对卫生政策和抗菌素耐药性具有重要启示。
title: Self-medication under uncertainty: Insights on drug quality and consumer behavior in Burkina Faso
title_zh: 不确定性下的自我用药：布基纳法索药品质量与消费者行为研究

abstract: Spatial price differences in agricultural markets, after accounting for transport costs, are often interpreted as evidence of market inefficiency. However, price differences may also reflect product quality variation, especially where formal grading systems are absent. This study uses a novel transaction-level dataset on paddy rice sales from rural Madagascar in 2022–2023, including laboratory-assessed grain quality indicators. By employing hedonic regressions, we construct a composite quality index to quantify the extent to which observed price variation across locations can be explained by quality differences. We find that varietal identity commands substantial price premiums, but measured physical and post-harvest quality attributes beyond variety explain only a small share of the observed price dispersion. Controlling for the quality attributes has little effect on conventional measures of market integration. This result suggests that buyers face difficulties in accurately assessing physical quality at the point of sale. In such contexts, buyers may rely on location-specific reputation as a substitute. Consistent with this, transactions originating from villages with higher average quality are associated with higher prices even after controlling for observable quality attributes. We interpret this as descriptive evidence consistent with reputation or relationship-based sourcing in settings with limited quality observability.
abstract_zh: 农业市场中的空间价格差异，在考虑运输成本后，常被视为市场效率低下的证据。然而，价格差异也可能反映产品质量的差异，尤其是在缺乏正式分级体系的地区。本研究利用2022至2023年间马达加斯加农村稻谷销售的独特交易层面数据集，其中包含实验室评估的谷物质量指标。通过运用特征回归模型，我们构建了一个综合质量指数，用以量化不同地点间观察到的价格差异在多大程度上可由质量差异解释。研究发现，品种身份能带来显著的价格溢价，但除品种外，测得的物理及收获后处理质量属性仅能解释观察到的价格离散度的一小部分。控制质量属性对传统的市场一体化衡量指标影响甚微。这一结果表明，买方在销售点难以准确评估物理质量。在此类情境下，买方可能依赖特定地点的声誉作为替代。与此一致的是，即便在控制可观测质量属性后，来自平均质量较高村庄的交易仍与较高价格相关联。我们将此解读为，在质量可观测性有限的环境中，与声誉或基于关系的采购模式相符的描述性证据。
title: Quality-driven price dispersion: Implications for testing market efficiency
title_zh: 质量驱动的价格离散：对市场效率检验的启示

abstract: This paper develops inference tools for the number of common latent factors across two large cross-sectional panels observed over a short time span (large n, small T). Our approach builds on a general test for determining the dimension of the intersection of two matrix column spaces, where each matrix is estimated with noise. The proposed test statistics are based on canonical correlations, and their asymptotic distributions are derived via perturbation methods. An empirical application to large cross-sections of monthly US stock returns and corporate bond returns finds that, on average, five latent factors influence both asset classes over an 18-month period. Our results suggest that a plausible candidate for a common factor is a stock portfolio with weights sorted on book leverage. Overall, the common factors between the two asset classes behave more like stock characteristic portfolios than bond characteristic portfolios, both in terms of pricing performance and time series dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对两个大型横截面面板在短时间跨度内（大n，小T）共同潜在因子数量的推断工具。我们的方法基于一个通用检验，用于确定两个矩阵列空间交集的维度，其中每个矩阵均含噪声估计。所提出的检验统计量基于典型相关，其渐近分布通过扰动方法推导得出。一项对月度美国股票回报和企业债券回报的大型横截面的实证应用发现，平均而言，在18个月期间内有五个潜在因子影响这两类资产。我们的结果表明，一个可能的共同因子候选是依据账面杠杆排序权重的股票组合。总体而言，这两类资产之间的共同因子在定价表现和时间序列动态方面，更类似于股票特征组合而非债券特征组合。
title: Testing for common latent factors across two short panels
title_zh: 检验两个短面板中的共同潜在因子

abstract: How many experimental studies would have come to different conclusions had they been run on larger samples? I show how to estimate the expected number of statistically significant results that a set of experiments would have reported had their sample sizes all been counterfactually increased. The proposed deconvolution estimator is asymptotically normal and adjusts for publication bias. Unlike related methods, this approach requires no assumptions of any kind about the distribution of true intervention treatment effects and allows for point masses. Simulations find good coverage even when the t-score is only approximately normal. An application to randomized trials (RCTs) published in economics journals finds that doubling every sample would increase the power of t-tests by 7.2 percentage points on average. This effect is smaller than for non-RCTs and comparable to systematic replications in laboratory psychology where previous studies enabled more accurate power calculations. This suggests that RCTs are on average relatively insensitive to sample size increases. Research funders who wish to raise power should generally consider sponsoring better-measured and higher quality experiments -- rather than only larger ones.
abstract_zh: 如果有更多实验研究在更大样本量下进行，它们会得出多少不同的结论？我展示了如何估计一组实验在样本量均被反事实增加的情况下，原本会报告出的统计显著结果数量的期望值。所提出的反卷积估计量渐近正态，并对发表偏倚进行了调整。与相关方法不同，此方法无需对真实干预处理效应的分布做出假设，并允许存在点质量。模拟结果显示，即使t分数仅近似正态，覆盖率也表现良好。应用于经济学期刊上发表的随机对照试验（RCTs）发现，将每个样本量加倍会使t检验的平均功效提高7.2个百分点。这一效应小于非随机对照试验，并与实验室心理学中的系统性重复研究相当，后者先前的研究使得功效计算更为精确。这表明随机对照试验平均而言对样本量增加的敏感性相对较低。希望提高功效的研究资助者通常应考虑资助测量更精确、质量更高的实验——而不仅仅是规模更大的实验。
title: Testing for underpowered literatures
title_zh: 检验低功效文献

abstract: Controlled environment agriculture is important in regions where traditional farming is constrained by short growing seasons. Of particular relevance, vertical farming is an innovative agricultural technology that enables year‐round production in Canada. However, Canadian consumers’ preferences for vertically farmed products remain a knowledge gap. This study investigates how nudges and local food labelling change market outcomes for identical food produced using different production methods. In a pre‐registered field experiment, 610 Canadian consumers bid on vertically farmed, greenhouse grown, and field grown lettuce, each further differentiated by local and non‐local labels, using the Becker‐DeGroot‐Marschak (BDM) mechanism. Nudges highlighting the benefits of vertical farming were randomized between‐subject at the individual level. Results show that consumers are willing to pay a significant premium for local lettuce, regardless of the production method. Although consumers respond positively to nudges, local labelling is by far the largest contributor to willingness‐to‐pay premium. This study underscores the importance of advancing innovative food production technologies to enhance the availability of locally grown food year‐round.
abstract_zh: 受控环境农业在传统农业受限于短生长季的地区具有重要意义。其中，垂直农业作为一种创新农业技术，能够在加拿大实现全年生产。然而，加拿大消费者对垂直农产品的偏好仍存在认知空白。本研究探讨了助推措施和本地食品标签如何改变采用不同生产方式生产的相同食品的市场结果。在一项预先注册的实地实验中，610名加拿大消费者使用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）机制，对垂直农场种植、温室种植和田间种植的生菜进行竞价，每种生菜进一步按本地和非本地标签进行区分。强调垂直农业益处的助推措施在个体层面进行了受试者间随机分配。结果表明，无论生产方式如何，消费者都愿意为本地生菜支付显著溢价。尽管消费者对助推措施反应积极，但本地标签是支付意愿溢价的最大贡献因素。本研究强调了推进创新食品生产技术以增强全年本地食品供应的重要性。
title: Is local all that matters?: An experiment on Canadian consumers’ preferences for produce
title_zh: 本地因素是否至关重要？——关于加拿大消费者对农产品偏好的实验研究

abstract: The concept of development has deeply divided the social sciences concerned with peoples and earth’s future. For many researchers and practitioners, variants of development are crucial normative cornerstones to frame and guide research and policy. Many critical scholars and activists associate the term with colonial, capitalist, extractivist, and patriarchal threats, and see it as the root cause of environmental degradation. In short, some study development as a solution, others as the problem. I call this rift the Development Studies Divide. After tracing diverse disciplinary roots, I discuss where the fault lines run and whether fruitful frictions could enrich the future of (critical) development studies. Despite stark differences in ideological, epistemological, and conceptual orientations, there is room for mutual learning, specifically across methodologies. A reflexive integration of critical perspectives with quantitative methods can substantiate critical claims beyond isolated case studies, address them at larger scales, and generate robust knowledge on alternatives to development beyond largely theory-driven proposals. It could also correct global empirical analyses that become problematic when their assumptions and interpretations are not grounded in the diverse histories, worldviews, and values of non-Western realities.
abstract_zh: 发展这一概念在关注人类与地球未来的社会科学领域引发了深刻分歧。对于众多研究者与实践者而言，发展的各种变体是构建和指导研究与政策的关键规范性基石。而许多批判性学者和活动家则将这一术语与殖民、资本主义、榨取主义和父权制的威胁相联系，视其为环境退化的根本原因。简言之，有人将发展视为解决方案，有人则视之为问题所在。我将这一裂痕称为“发展研究鸿沟”。在追溯其多元学科根源后，我探讨了断层线的分布位置，以及富有成效的摩擦是否能丰富（批判性）发展研究的未来。尽管在意识形态、认识论和概念取向上存在显著差异，但仍有相互学习的空间，尤其是在方法论层面。将批判视角与定量方法进行反思性整合，能够超越孤立的案例研究，在更大尺度上证实批判性主张，并为超越发展之外的替代方案生成超越纯理论驱动的稳健知识。同时，这也能纠正全球实证分析中的问题——当这些分析的假设和解释未植根于非西方现实的多元历史、世界观和价值观时，它们便会变得问题重重。
title: The development studies divide: fierce fault lines or fruitful frictions?
title_zh: 发展研究的分歧：激烈的断层线还是富有成效的摩擦？

abstract: We investigate suppliers’ incentive to purchase data in a supply chain where multiple competing suppliers face uncertain downstream demand and may choose to acquire noisy demand signals (data) to improve their decisions. We identify a competition-reinforcement effect: data acquisition can trigger more aggressive competition among suppliers, which in turn erodes their incentive to purchase data. We show that this competition reinforcement effect could outweigh the conventional informed-decision benefit of better demand information, especially when input substitutability is low. As a result, intensified competition could reduce suppliers’ willingness to buy data, and may even generate net welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了供应链中供应商购买数据的动机，在该供应链中，多个相互竞争的供应商面临不确定的下游需求，并可能选择获取有噪声的需求信号（数据）以改进其决策。我们识别出一种竞争强化效应：数据获取可能引发供应商之间更激烈的竞争，这反过来又削弱了他们购买数据的动机。我们表明，这种竞争强化效应可能超过更好的需求信息所带来的传统知情决策收益，尤其是在投入品替代性较低的情况下。因此，竞争加剧可能降低供应商购买数据的意愿，甚至可能产生净福利损失。
title: Supplier competition and the incentive to purchase data
title_zh: 供应商竞争与数据购买激励

abstract: Using an instrument for U.S. Treasury supply, we show that convenience yields on medium- and long-term Treasurys are much more sensitive to supply than those on short-term Treasurys, which respond little. Over the past two decades, fiscal expansion has substantially reduced medium- and long-term convenience yields, at times pushing them below zero, while short-term convenience yields have declined toward zero. Quantitatively, we estimate that increased Treasury supply explains a large share of the secular decline in medium- and long-term convenience yields, lowering the total seigniorage revenue from Treasury issuance by about one-third.
abstract_zh: 利用美国国债供给的工具变量，我们证明中长期国债的便利收益率对供给的敏感度远高于短期国债，后者反应甚微。过去二十年中，财政扩张显著降低了中长期便利收益率，有时甚至将其推至负值，而短期便利收益率则逐步向零趋近。定量分析显示，国债供给增加解释了中长期便利收益率长期下降的很大一部分，使国债发行的总铸币税收入减少了约三分之一。
title: Convenience lost
title_zh: 便利的丧失

abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本，使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔，我们计算了企业配对利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业还在卡特尔解散后立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化对手利润的企业参与共谋而对手未参与的企业配对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。
title: Common Ownership and Collusion
title_zh: 共同所有权与合谋

abstract: Research indicates that a city’s total factor productivity (TFP) correlates with its size, with larger cities exhibiting higher TFP. However, some smaller cities can achieve high TFP by borrowing their size from surrounding cities, achieving the size necessary to support the benefits of agglomeration. This study uses data from industrial firms in 13 mature city clusters in China to explore how borrowed size influences TFP. The findings reveal that borrowed size significantly enhances firms’ TFP, acting as a substitute for city size. Heterogeneity analysis shows that technology-intensive and downstream industries in the industrial chain are more dependent on borrowed size, whereas state-owned firms face challenges due to intergovernmental competition, making it difficult for them to benefit from borrowed size. The positive effects of borrowed size rely on inter-city connections: lower administrative barriers, a more flattened spatial structure of city clusters, and a denser transportation network amplify its benefits. Mechanism analysis indicates that large cities can borrow size from surrounding smaller cities to develop productive services beyond their capacity, while smaller cities can share the productive service functions of large cities and specialize in manufacturing. This clear functional division helps improve firms’ TFP. KEYWORDS: Borrowed size total factor productivity city clusters city functional division firms JEL CLASSIFICATION: O25 R12 R58 Acknowledgements The authors appreciate the insightful and constructive comments of the anonymous reviewers.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，城市全要素生产率与其规模相关，大城市展现出更高的全要素生产率。然而，一些较小的城市可以通过向周边城市“借用规模”来实现高全要素生产率，从而获得支撑集聚效应所需的规模。本研究利用中国13个成熟城市群中的工业企业数据，探讨借用规模如何影响全要素生产率。研究发现，借用规模显著提升了企业的全要素生产率，起到了城市规模的替代作用。异质性分析显示，技术密集型产业和产业链下游行业对借用规模的依赖度更高，而国有企业因受政府间竞争的影响，难以从借用规模中获益。借用规模的积极效应依赖于城市间的联系：较低的行政壁垒、更为扁平的城市群空间结构以及更密集的交通网络能够放大其益处。机制分析表明，大城市可以借用周边小城市的规模，发展超出自身承载能力的生产性服务业，而小城市则可以共享大城市的生产性服务功能，专注于制造业。这种明确的功能分工有助于提升企业的全要素生产率。关键词：借用规模；全要素生产率；城市群；城市功能分工；企业 JEL分类号：O25 R12 R58 致谢：作者感谢匿名审稿人的深刻见解和建设性意见。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Borrowed size, city functional division, and total factor productivity of firms: a study based on city clusters in China
title_zh: 借用规模、城市功能分工与企业全要素生产率——基于中国城市群的研究

abstract: Based on panel data from 2011 to 2022 covering all Chinese provinces except Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and Tibet, this study constructs a multi-weighted, multi-scenario spatial Durbin model to examine the structural stability of the relationship between agricultural industrial agglomeration and rural labour outflow. The results indicate that the local effect of agricultural industrial agglomeration on labour outflow is not a structurally stable relationship, but rather an average effect dependent on specific contextual conditions. Spatial spillover effects are generally limited and lack robustness, thereby refuting the implicit assumption in existing research that ‘agglomeration effects possess cross-spatial stability’. These spillover effects exhibit directional consistency only under specific spatial linkages and institutional conditions, suggesting that they are closer to a context-triggered latent mechanism. The moderating role of contextual variables indicates that this effect is not universally present but is embedded within specific spatial structures, thereby revealing that it is essentially a conditional process dependent on spatial structure. Based on these findings, this paper defines the scope of agricultural agglomeration effects from the perspective of spatial structure and institutional conditions, revealing that these effects hold only under specific forms of connectivity and contextual conditions. KEYWORDS: Agricultural industrial agglomeration rural labour outflow spatial Durbin model spatial spillover JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q18 O15
abstract_zh: 基于2011至2022年间中国除香港、澳门、台湾及西藏外所有省份的面板数据，本研究构建了一个多权重、多情景的空间杜宾模型，旨在考察农业产业集聚与农村劳动力外流之间关系的结构稳定性。研究结果显示，农业产业集聚对劳动力外流的本地效应并非一种结构稳定的关系，而是一种依赖于特定情境条件的平均效应。空间溢出效应总体有限且缺乏稳健性，从而反驳了现有研究中隐含的“集聚效应具有跨空间稳定性”的假设。这些溢出效应仅在特定的空间联系和制度条件下表现出方向一致性，表明它们更接近于一种由情境触发的潜在机制。情境变量的调节作用表明，这一效应并非普遍存在，而是嵌入于特定的空间结构之中，从而揭示其本质上是一个依赖于空间结构的条件过程。基于上述发现，本文从空间结构与制度条件的视角界定了农业集聚效应的适用范围，揭示这些效应仅在特定的连接形式与情境条件下成立。关键词：农业产业集聚；农村劳动力外流；空间杜宾模型；空间溢出；JEL分类：Q18；O15
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Research on the mechanism of agricultural industrial agglomeration’s Impact on rural labour outflow: an empirical analysis based on China’s inter-provincial panel data
title_zh: 农业产业集聚对农村劳动力外流的影响机制研究——基于中国省际面板数据的实证分析

abstract: Reported estimates of the size premium, the tendency of smaller firms to earn higher average returns than larger firms, vary widely across studies, countries, periods, and designs. We examine whether generalized trust and rule of law help account for that heterogeneity. Small firms are more opaque and more dependent on outside finance, so the enforcement and information environment should matter more for them than for large firms. We study 1,613 reported size-slope estimates from 105 studies and 31 countries. The meta-regressions control for study design, specification, precision, publication context, and market and macro-financial conditions; Bayesian model averaging assesses uncertainty over the control set. The more stable association is with rule of law, and it runs against the intuitive expectation that better legal institutions shrink the premium: stronger rule of law is associated with more negative reported size slopes, hence larger conventional size premia. The trust association is conditional and less precisely estimated: where rule of law is weak, higher generalized trust is linked to less negative reported slopes (and thus a weaker premium), and this link fades as rule of law strengthens. Formal and informal institutions thus help organize part of the disagreement in this literature, although the analysis concerns variation in reported estimates and does not identify causal effects.
abstract_zh: 关于规模溢价（即小公司平均回报率高于大公司的趋势）的估计结果，在不同研究、国家、时期及设计间差异显著。我们探讨了普遍信任与法治是否有助于解释这一异质性。小公司更为不透明，且更依赖外部融资，因此执法与信息环境对其影响应大于大公司。我们分析了来自105项研究、31个国家的1,613个规模斜率估计值。元回归分析控制了研究设计、规格、精确度、发表背景及市场与宏观金融条件；贝叶斯模型平均法评估了控制集的不确定性。与法治的关联更为稳定，且与直觉预期相反——更好的法律机构并未缩小溢价：更强的法治与更负的规模斜率报告值相关，从而对应更大的传统规模溢价。信任的关联则具有条件性且估计精度较低：在法治薄弱的环境中，较高的普遍信任与较不显著的负斜率报告值（即较弱的溢价）相关，而这一关联随法治加强而减弱。因此，正式与非正式制度有助于部分梳理该文献中的分歧，尽管分析涉及报告估计值的变异性，并未识别因果效应。
title: Trust, Rule of Law, and the Size Premium: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 信任、法治与规模溢价：来自元分析的证据

title: Corrigendum to “Development and interdisciplinarity: additional insights on the ‘economics silo’” [World Dev. 205(2026) 107435]
title_zh: 更正启事：“发展与跨学科：‘经济学孤岛’的补充见解” [World Dev. 205(2026) 107435]

abstract: This paper documents that the traditional sovereign-bank nexus has morphed into a broader nexus that now also includes non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs): the sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. The classical sovereign-bank nexus has been a major financial stability concern following the eurozone crisis. Since then, sovereign debt levels have increased substantially in many major economies, while NBFIs’ footprint in sovereign bond markets has grown significantly. This paper examines the transmission of risks among banks, sovereigns and NBFIs using European bank-level data and global country-level data. We find that banks’ direct sovereign exposures have recently become less important in explaining the co-movement between bank and sovereign risk. By contrast, banks’ exposures to NBFIs have become a significant determinant of the bank-sovereign risk co-movement. We also find evidence that NBFIs’ sovereign debt holdings have become important drivers of the co-movement between NBFI and sovereign risk.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了传统的“主权-银行”关联已演变为一个更广泛的关联网络，现亦纳入非银行金融机构（NBFIs）：即“主权-银行-NBFI”关联。在欧元区危机之后，经典的主权-银行关联一直是金融稳定关注的重点。自那时起，许多主要经济体的主权债务水平大幅上升，而NBFIs在主权利率市场中的参与度显著增强。本文利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了银行、主权国家与NBFIs之间的风险传导机制。研究发现，银行对主权的直接敞口在解释银行与主权风险联动方面的作用近期已减弱。相反，银行对NBFIs的敞口已成为银行-主权风险联动的重要决定因素。此外，证据表明，NBFIs持有的主权债务已成为NBFI与主权风险联动的重要驱动因素。
title: The evolving nexus: sovereigns, banks and NBFIs
title_zh: 演变中的关联：主权国家、银行与非银行金融机构

abstract: This study examines social‐class and urban–rural differentials in childhood mortality in Sweden from 1880 to 1910, a period of steady mortality decline, ongoing industrialization, and urbanization. Urbanization brought improvements in water quality and sanitation but also increased risks from overcrowding, pollution, and infectious diseases. It remains unexplored whether these changes narrowed or widened the class gap in infant and child mortality. We use full‐count Swedish censuses linked to the Swedish Death Index (SDI), which provides near‐comprehensive coverage of all deaths and allows for reliable estimation of mortality in ages 1–9 years. Detailed census data enable analysis of parental household characteristics. Due to undercounting of infant deaths, we use under‐five sex ratios as a proxy for infant mortality. Results show a strong urban penalty in both infant and child mortality in the late nineteenth century, which diminished in the early twentieth century. Pronounced class differences existed in child mortality in both urban and rural areas but not in infant mortality. Although absolute class differences narrowed over time, relative inequalities persisted in urban areas but largely disappeared in rural settings. These findings reveal substantial inequalities in child survival during industrialization linked to both urban residence and social class.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1880年至1910年间瑞典儿童死亡率的阶层与城乡差异，这一时期死亡率持续下降，工业化与城市化同步推进。城市化带来了水质与卫生条件的改善，但也增加了过度拥挤、污染及传染病传播的风险。这些变化究竟是缩小还是扩大了婴儿及儿童死亡率的阶层差距，此前尚无研究探讨。我们利用与瑞典死亡索引（SDI）关联的全量瑞典人口普查数据，该索引几乎覆盖所有死亡记录，可对1至9岁年龄段的死亡率进行可靠估计。详尽的普查数据使我们能够分析父母家庭特征。鉴于婴儿死亡存在漏报问题，我们采用五岁以下性别比作为婴儿死亡率的代理指标。结果显示，19世纪末城市地区在婴儿及儿童死亡率方面均存在显著劣势，但这一劣势在20世纪初有所减弱。城乡地区儿童死亡率均存在显著阶层差异，而婴儿死亡率则未见明显阶层分化。尽管绝对阶层差距随时间推移有所缩小，但相对不平等在城市地区持续存在，而在农村地区则基本消失。这些发现揭示了工业化时期儿童生存机会中与城市居住及社会阶层相关的显著不平等。
title: The mortality gradient in town and country: Social class and childhood mortality in Sweden at the turn of the twentieth century
title_zh: 城乡死亡率梯度：二十世纪初瑞典的社会阶层与儿童死亡率

abstract: Decisions to pursue higher education are shaped by economic incentives, peer effects, and expectations about future returns. This paper develops a non-linear dynamic model of educational participation for study fields in which the motivations to enrol are heterogeneous and cannot be reduced to a single driver. Agents allocate resources between education and consumption while their preferences evolve endogenously. Followers are reinforced by aggregate participation, while Positional Agents respond to social distinctiveness and to an endogenous wage premium that declines with the supply of educated workers. We show that the interaction between imitation, positional concerns, and labour-market feedback can generate endogenous cycles and irregular dynamics, especially for intermediate mixtures of behavioural types. Allowing population shares to evolve adds a further source of instability through switching between behavioural rules. Finally, policy interventions are not necessarily stabilizing: counter-cyclical cost subsidies may discipline enrolment, whereas strong behavioural signalling can amplify imitative responses and generate overreaction.
abstract_zh: 追求高等教育的决策受到经济激励、同伴效应及对未来回报预期的影响。本文针对学习领域构建了一个非线性动态教育参与模型，其中入学动机具有异质性，无法归结为单一驱动因素。行为主体在资源分配上兼顾教育与消费，而其偏好则内生演化。追随者受总体参与度强化，而地位追求者则对社会独特性及随受教育劳动力供给增加而下降的内生工资溢价作出反应。我们表明，模仿行为、地位关注与劳动力市场反馈之间的相互作用可产生内生周期及不规则动态，尤其在行为类型中等混合比例时更为显著。允许人口份额演化，通过行为规则间的切换进一步引入不稳定来源。最后，政策干预未必具有稳定作用：逆周期成本补贴可能约束入学，而强烈的行为信号则可能放大模仿反应并引发过度反应。
title: Nonlinear dynamics of higher education participation under social influence and endogenous returns
title_zh: 社会影响与内生回报下高等教育参与的非线性动态

abstract: Anti-immigration policies often rest on the premise that immigrants worsen native-born employment and wages. This column uses data from 2000 to 2023 to estimate the impact of immigration to the US on national wages and employment, focusing on national rather than local impacts. The authors find that in these two decades, net immigration to the US was heavily college-intensive and raised the wages of less-educated natives. It also increased natives’ employment. Natives’ reallocation into higher-paying, communication-intensive occupations, complementary to those filled by immigrants, is one mechanism behind these gains.
abstract_zh: 反移民政策往往基于一个前提，即移民会恶化本土出生者的就业和工资状况。本文利用2000年至2023年的数据，评估了美国移民对全国工资和就业的影响，重点关注全国层面而非地方层面的效应。作者发现，在这二十年里，美国净移民高度集中于受过大学教育的人群，并提升了教育程度较低的本土出生者的工资水平。同时，移民也增加了本土出生者的就业机会。本土出生者向薪酬更高、沟通密集型职业的重新配置，与移民所从事的职业形成互补，是这些收益背后的机制之一。
title: Revisiting immigration’s effect on US wages and employment
title_zh: 重新审视移民对美国工资与就业的影响

abstract: Macroprudential policy is designed to make the financial system safer, but it can also reshape the finance available to innovative firms. Using patent data matched to 2,844 firms in 21 European countries over 1990-2021, this column finds that macroprudential tightening is followed by lower patenting and lower patent quality. The effect is strongest when credit growth is weak and among financially constrained firms, and it is concentrated in instruments that directly restrict credit. By contrast, financial-resilience tools carry no measurable short-run innovation cost and may support innovation over longer horizons. The findings suggest that policymakers can protect financial stability without systematically penalising innovation, provided they are selective about which instruments they deploy.
abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策旨在提升金融体系的安全性，但同时也可能重塑创新型企业可获得的融资环境。本文利用1990年至2021年间覆盖21个欧洲国家2844家企业的专利数据，发现宏观审慎政策的收紧伴随着专利申请数量及专利质量的下降。这一效应在信贷增长疲软时期及面临融资约束的企业中尤为显著，且主要集中在直接限制信贷的工具上。相比之下，金融韧性工具在短期内未带来可测的创新成本，并可能在更长时期内支持创新活动。研究结果表明，政策制定者能够在保障金融稳定的同时，避免系统性抑制创新，前提是审慎选择所采用的工具类型。
authors: Xuan Viet Ho, Brigitte Granville, Luu Duc Toan Huynh, Steven Ongena
title: Macroprudential policy may curb innovation – but instrument choice matters
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策可能抑制创新——但工具选择至关重要

abstract: This paper investigates the conditions under which mergers between corporate social responsibility (CSR) firms are both privately profitable and socially desirable. We develop a Cournot model of quantity competition with product differentiation, featuring both CSR and non-CSR firms. CSR firms engage in observable CSR investment, which affects consumer willingness to pay depending on the level of CSR cognition in the market. We analyse a two-stage game in which CSR firms decide whether to propose a merger and a (myopic) Antitrust Authority (AA) determines whether to authorise it. Our results show that the profitability and approval of such mergers crucially depend on the degree of product differentiation and consumer sensitivity to CSR. When products are sufficiently complementary (or weakly substitutable) and CSR awareness is high, the merger increases both firm profits and consumer surplus, leading to regulatory approval. However, when the merger induces the exit of non-CSR competitors and products are homogeneous, a divergence emerges between private and social incentives, with the AA often blocking otherwise profitable mergers. These findings provide novel insights into merger policy design in settings where ethical competition and market power coexist.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业社会责任（CSR）企业之间的合并既具有私人盈利性又具有社会合意性的条件。我们构建了一个包含产品差异化的数量竞争古诺模型，其中同时包含CSR企业与非CSR企业。CSR企业进行可观察的CSR投资，该投资根据市场中CSR认知水平影响消费者的支付意愿。我们分析了一个两阶段博弈，其中CSR企业决定是否提议合并，而（短视的）反垄断机构（AA）决定是否批准该合并。我们的结果表明，此类合并的盈利性与批准与否关键取决于产品差异化程度和消费者对CSR的敏感度。当产品充分互补（或弱替代）且CSR意识较高时，合并既增加企业利润又提升消费者剩余，从而获得监管批准。然而，当合并导致非CSR竞争对手退出且产品同质时，私人激励与社会激励之间出现分歧，反垄断机构往往阻止原本有利可图的合并。这些发现为在伦理竞争与市场力量并存的背景下设计合并政策提供了新颖见解。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Strategic corporate social responsibility and merger decisions
title_zh: 战略性企业社会责任与并购决策

abstract: Thailand's transition to high-income status is, at its core, an urban challenge. Bangkok generates nearly half of the national gross domestic product, yet its dominance is increasingly constrained by congestion, environmental stress, and diminishing returns to further concentration. Successive National Spatial Development Strategies have called for a more multi-nodal urban hierarchy, but the analytical basis for evaluating that ambition has remained thin. This paper builds and calibrates a Dynamic Recursive Spatial Quantitative General Equilibrium model for Thailand's urban system from 2025 to 2050, and uses it to evaluate three counterfactual policy portfolios that allocate the same aggregate productivity-investment envelope (roughly 2.3 percent of 2030 urban gross domestic product) across Bangkok and the eleven designated secondary cities in different proportions: a Bangkok-leaning portfolio (80/20), a balanced portfolio (50/50), and a secondary-leaning portfolio (20/80). The Bangkok-leaning portfolio leads through 2045, but the secondary-leaning portfolio overtakes it between 2045 and 2050, delivering a 12.38 percent gain in national gross domestic product per capita above the no-investment baseline against 11.62 percent for the Bangkok-leaning alternative. The balanced portfolio is dominated by both skewed alternatives in 2050, reflecting a threshold property of agglomeration economies. A two-dimensional envelope-by-split sweep shows that the relative ranking is genuinely contingent on the scale and horizon of the commitment: below a certain tipping point, the Bangkok-leaning portfolio dominates; above it, the secondary-leaning portfolio does. A modest, well-allocated spatial-investment program is unlikely to be the engine of Thailand's high-income transition; sufficient scale of commitment is a precondition.
abstract_zh: 泰国迈向高收入地位的转型，其核心在于城市挑战。曼谷贡献了近半数的国内生产总值，但其主导地位日益受到拥堵、环境压力及进一步集聚收益递减的制约。历次国家空间发展战略均呼吁构建更为多节点的城市层级体系，然而评估这一愿景的分析基础仍显薄弱。本文构建并校准了一个适用于泰国城市系统的动态递归空间量化一般均衡模型，时间跨度为2025年至2050年，并利用该模型评估了三种反事实政策组合，这些组合将相同的总生产率投资包（约占2030年城市国内生产总值的2.3%）按不同比例分配给曼谷及十一个指定次级城市：偏向曼谷的组合（80/20）、均衡组合（50/50）及偏向次级城市的组合（20/80）。偏向曼谷的组合在2045年前领先，但偏向次级城市的组合在2045年至2050年间超越前者，使全国人均国内生产总值较无投资基准线高出12.38%，而偏向曼谷的替代方案则为11.62%。均衡组合在2050年被两种倾斜方案所主导，这反映了集聚经济的阈值特性。二维的包络-分配扫描显示，相对排名确实取决于承诺的规模与时间跨度：低于某一临界点，偏向曼谷的组合占优；高于该临界点，则偏向次级城市的组合胜出。一个适度且配置得当的空间投资计划不太可能成为泰国高收入转型的引擎；足够的承诺规模是前提条件。
